pope.prompt: Edit the supplied NAI5 full-body Witness Assembly Pontiff design into a finished transparent game enemy sprite. Preserve his elderly severe face, short silver-gray hair, ivory ceremonial mantle over charcoal modern winter clothes, restrained brass circular emblem, wrapped forearms, full boots, and outstretched open palm. Entire body, face, gaze, forward hand and stance face SCREEN-LEFT, same eye-level three-quarter side camera. Keep the complete figure including fingertips, trailing mantle and soles inside the canvas with clear margins. Simplify ragged cloth edges into a few deliberate large shapes, correct fingers, no new accessories. This is an urban abnormal-ability cult leader in a quarantined city, not a medieval armored king. Genuine transparent background, no black fill, no white fill, no checkerboard painted into image, no ground shadow, no floor, no lettering or frame. 画风：有明确笔形与取舍的手绘动漫插画，哑光、不透明的色块覆色，选择性的细线融入色面。先用连成大组的综合色铺完整形状，再在少数转折处用钝端短条、宽弧形或长条笔压出体积。大片安静底色与少量较密的重点交替出现，细节不均匀分摊到所有表面。衣料使用大底色、相连主投影和少数宽转折，不补细褶皱与碎高光；重要遮挡边清楚，其余轮廓随明暗融入色面。面部保留年龄，脸眼与关键手势画准，肤面哑光，避免塑料式精修、全图噪点、逐件黑缝、重复碎边。Single isolated enemy asset, no other figures.

Reconstruct the missing top contour of his hair naturally, then scale the COMPLETE existing figure down just enough to have generous transparent space on ALL four sides (at least 6 percent of canvas height above the head and below the soles; at least 5 percent width beside outstretched fingertips and trailing cloak). Keep every part of the current design, face, hands, ivory cloak, charcoal clothes, brass emblem, boots, and matte painted shading unchanged in appearance. Body, face, eyes and outstretched palm keep facing SCREEN-LEFT. Do not mirror, change pose, change clothing, add objects or add a background. True alpha transparency; no ground shadow, no painted checkerboard, no text. One isolated game battle sprite. Complete hair and both boot soles fully inside canvas, with transparent margin.
